title: What's New: Migrate Record Links and Notes (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: What are record links and notes
Cloud migration setup and buffer table
Demo: migrating record links and notes

features.name: Record links and notes migration
features.description: New capability to migrate record links and notes from on-premises database to cloud instance as part of the cloud migration process. Previously, these had to be manually brought over.
caveats: Record links and notes are placed in a buffer table first to prevent overwriting existing records
Migration action must be run after data replication
Migration should be done before user mapping to preserve correct user references

features.name: Cloud migration management page
features.description: A page where users can check the status of cloud migration setup and data replication completion.

features.name: Migrate record links and notes action
features.description: Action button available on cloud migration management page that transfers record links and notes from the buffer table to the actual table after replication completes.
caveats: Must be run after data replication so records are moved to buffer table first

features.name: Warnings field for record link migration
features.description: A new field on the cloud migration management page that alerts users when the record link table has not been migrated since the last replication, helping prevent forgotten migrations.
